liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **High Time** (1 review): Reviewer had been waiting to hear High Time from this show [4]
- ***Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer came for the Fire on the Mountain rap and the banjo-bass playing [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bown-Eyed Women**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **High Time**: rare: 13 archived performances [12]
- **Happy 29th Birthday Matthew Stankiewicz/Outro**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **Rhythym Devils**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]

## The recordings

- **deadco2023-07-02** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 184 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [1]
- **deadco2023-07-02.EJL95**: source not stated; 19 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the text file skips track 15, so track 7 seems missing; it's only a naming error [6]
- **deadco2023-07-02.fob-schoeps-mk41.zman.lee.165846.flac2444**: source not stated; 19 songs; 183 min [3]

## Around the show

- Lineup listed: Weir, Mickey Hart (including rap vocals), Mayer, Jeff Chimenti on keys, and Oteil Burbridge, who plays banjo bass [3]
- Uploader promotes a charity shirt for the National Brain Tumor Society, sold by brain cancer survivor Jon Heller [2]
- Reviewer asks whether the taper also attended Noblesville and says they are seeking a tape from the pavilion there [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2023-07-02**: taped by Z-Man; transferred by Z-Man; source: Schoeps MK41'S>Sound Devices Mix-Pre 6 II (48/32) [1]. Also: Z-Man taped with Schoeps MK41 mics into a Sound Devices Mix-Pre 6 II, positioned 90 feet from stage, 6.5 feet high; Mix-Pre 6 II output went through Sound Forge 10.0 and CD Wave to 16-bit FLAC; Ellis Schoch assisted, Brett Garcia lent mics [1]
- **deadco2023-07-02.EJL95**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: Channels 1 & 2: AKG c414 XLII Hypercardioids PAS 20" apart > Channels 3 & 4: Audio Technica 3031 Cardioids PAS 32" apart > Channels 5 & 6: Line Audio OM1… [2]
- **deadco2023-07-02.fob-schoeps-mk41.zman.lee.165846.flac2444**: taped by Steve Ziegler (Z-Man); transferred by Brian Lee; source: Schoeps MK41 (DIN/FOB/DFC/KFC/AARP/6'high) > Sound Devices MixPre 6 II @ 32/44.1 [3]. Also: Z-Man's Schoeps MK41 32-bit master files were processed in Sound Forge 17 Pro and released as 24/44.1 FLAC [3]
